anchors.paper_title: NeuroVox: Bilingual Brain-to-Speech Translation and Neural Activity Detection
anchors.paper_venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
anchors.reason: Zenodo record 10.5281/zenodo.13332808 is the source deposit named in the README; it describes the bilingual sEEG dataset (Chinese, English, digit reading) that this derivative redistributes.

anchors.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
anchors.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software
anchors.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiological data into BIDS, used in converting this dataset, not a paper describing the CerebroVoice data.

anchors.paper_title: iEEG-BIDS, extending the Brain Imaging Data Structure specification to human intracranial electrophysiology
anchors.reason: iEEG-BIDS is a specification for organizing iEEG data in BIDS, used to format this sEEG dataset; it does not describe the CerebroVoice data.

metadata.methods_description: Intracranial recordings were acquired at 1000 Hz using a Nihon Kohden EEG-1200 system with platinum-iridium depth electrodes. Participants read Chinese, English, and digit stimuli (about 73 min for SUB1 and 76 min for SUB2). Preprocessed NPY derivatives (LFS, HGA, BBS) were converted to BIDS-iEEG.
